about: Raw Deepgram Flux messages recorded once for the 3a audio bench (synthetic TTS voices, invented text, contact placeholders only): the provider's real TurnInfo sequences (StartOfTurn, Update, EagerEndOfTurn, TurnResumed, EndOfTurn) for testing the ear's feed. `arrived_ms` is when the message reached the client from the start of the stream; `sent_through_ms` how much audio had been sent by then. Request ids and wall clock removed. Each recording has its generator labels (what was said, by whom, when).

es-long-00-g9.about: long monologue-like thoughts, many turns, several TurnResumed

en-clean-03-g9.about: clean thoughts, a turn built from many Update messages, one TurnResumed

es-pauses4000-00-g9u1.about: one utterance with 4 s pauses inside thoughts (§5.2): EagerEndOfTurn then TurnResumed mid-thought

en-interruption-00-g9.about: another voice cutting in: two TurnResumed

mix-pauses1500-00-g9u1.about: ES/EN mixed thought with 1.5 s pauses, one utterance
